description: Plan moving the hard-coded texts of three components into translation files: every component is covered, locales/en.json is filled before a Polish locales/pl.json is added, and no step names a file that does not exist.

criteria: The plan adds keys for every text of src/components/Header.js, Footer.js and LoginForm.js to locales/en.json, switches the components to t(key), and only then adds locales/pl.json with the same keys.
